gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the FiiO DM13 sends only SBC and aptX codecs (no AAC or LDAC) and comes in a 'Standard version' that cannot send Bluetooth at all. So AirPods (AAC/SBC) or an AAC/LDAC headphone such as the soundcore Space One gets plain SBC from it, the same as from the SBC-only Shanling EC Play.
standout_why: Compared against macmyths.com, rottenwifi.com, trettitre.com and howtovr.com/best-cd-players-with-bluetooth. macmyths says outright that none of its sources names codecs for any player. rottenwifi gives no codec for any product. trettitre only says 'Check whether the player specifies codec support'. howtovr names a codec only for the Panasonic SC-PM270 (SBC). None of the four covers the DM13 Standard-vs-Bluetooth version, the DM13's codec list, or which headphones fall back to SBC. They do list car-stereo exclusions, but only for the Sunoony, MEGATEK, ARAFUNA and ENVYCLOUD players. av.com (rank 1) returned HTTP 403 and was not compared.
decides: The DM13's aptX HD / aptX Low Latency edge over the Shanling EC Play (SBC-only transmit) is real only with aptX-capable headphones. With AirPods or an AAC/LDAC headphone like the soundcore Space One, both players send SBC, so the pick should rest on battery, anti-skip and price, not codec. The shopper must also buy the DM13 Bluetooth version, because FiiO says the Standard version cannot transmit. The Panasonic SC-PM270 and GPX BCB119B-type boomboxes only receive from a phone. For wireless headphones, only the DM13 BT, the EC Play, or a transmitter like the 1Mii B06TX on an existing player qualify.

findings.label: Bluetooth transmit codecs
findings.value: SBC, aptX, aptX Low Latency, aptX HD (AAC and LDAC not listed)
findings.note: Spec row 'Bluetooth transmission: Supports SBC/aptX/aptX Low Latency/aptX HD'. The output modes listed are PRE OUT / USB OUT / SPDIF OUT / BLUE OUT. The page gives no Bluetooth version or range.

findings.label: Version that cannot send Bluetooth
findings.value: Standard version: no Bluetooth transmit; only the Bluetooth version transmits
findings.note: Footnote, shown twice on the maker page: '*Standard version cannot transmit Bluetooth.'

findings.label: Maker-stated headphone/speaker/car exclusions
findings.value: Some headphones/speakers connect at SBC only; some car Bluetooth systems and specific headphone/speaker models may not be supported
findings.note: Footnotes: '*Due to Bluetooth chipset and protocol compatibility limitations, some headphones/speakers only support SBC.' and '*Some car Bluetooth systems and specific headphone/speaker models may not be supported.' FiiO does not name the excluded models.

findings.label: Bluetooth pairing procedure
findings.value: Short-press power to switch to BLUE OUT; long-press Previous to pair; long-press Next to clear the existing pairing
findings.source_title: How to use the Bluetooth transmitting function of DM13? (FiiO Support)
findings.note: After pairing, the DM13 screen shows the active Bluetooth codec, so the shopper can check whether they got aptX HD or SBC.

findings.label: USB storage limit for firmware updates and CD ripping
findings.value: FAT32 only; USB-C flash drive of 32 GB or less recommended
findings.note: Footnote: '*Only supports FAT32 formatted storage devices. A Type-C USB flash drive with 32GB or lower capacity is recommended for firmware updates or ripping.' Rips are saved as WAV.

findings.label: CD-R / CD-RW limit
findings.value: Occasional frame skipping on some CD-R and CD-RW discs is stated as normal
findings.note: Footnote: '*Due to differences in disc materials and recording environments, occasional frame skipping when reading some CD-R and CD-RW discs is normal.' FiiO also says the ESP switch improves playback stability but not disc reading.

findings.label: Bluetooth codecs by direction
findings.value: Transmit: SBC only. Receive: LDAC, AAC, SBC. Bluetooth 6.0
findings.note: Maker text: 'Bluetooth Transmitter: SBC', 'Bluetooth Receiver: LDAC/AAC/SBC', 'Bluetooth Version: 6.0'. Supported discs: CD/CD-RW/CD-R (MP3-CD not listed). MSRP 199 USD; the page says 'Check with dealers for USA pricing'.

findings.label: Codecs AirPods accept
findings.value: AAC and SBC only (no aptX, aptX HD or LDAC)
findings.source_title: Apple clarifies lack of high-definition Bluetooth codec support for AirPods Max and AirPods Pro 2 (Notebookcheck)
findings.note: Notebookcheck's Alex Alderson (24 Nov 2022): 'Apple has remained resolute with AAC and SBC'. Inference: the DM13 offers no AAC and the EC Play sends SBC only, so the only codec they share with AirPods is SBC. The article covers AirPods Max and Pro 2; newer AirPods not checked.

findings.label: Codecs (pairing cell with DM13 / EC Play)
findings.value: SBC, AAC, LDAC (no aptX), so SBC from either CD player
findings.note: SoundGuys' Chase Bernath (13 Nov 2024): LDAC with compatible Android devices, 'regular SBC and AAC codecs for all other devices'. The overlap with the DM13 list (SBC/aptX/aptX LL/aptX HD) is SBC only. Dealectric already lists this headphone (soundcore-space-one).
